messages.text: Sorry you're running into trouble. I can see you're on the Harlo L. page. What happens when you try to sign up? Does a button do nothing, do you get an error message, or does the form not accept your email? If there's an error, paste the exact wording here and I'll get it sorted.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)
Handed to the team · Signup form error on launch page, cannot add them to the list myself

Thanks for the screenshot, Ariel. That error is on our side, not something you did.

Try one quick thing: clear the phone field, since it's optional, and tap Sign me up again. Phone numbers without a country code sometimes trip that form.

Even if it still fails, I've passed your name and email to the team so they can add you to the Harlo L. launch list by hand. Someone will pick up your ticket and confirm it with you by email. Loto goes on sale Friday, November 20 at 12:00 PM ET.

That's the form failing, not you, so there's no need to keep trying it. The team already has your name and email for the Harlo L. list, along with this error. Someone will pick up your ticket, fix the form and confirm with you by email.

Loto goes on sale Friday, November 20 at 12:00 PM ET, at $799. If you'd like to know more about it before launch day, ask me here.
Before you go, one thing: what got you interested in the Harlo L.?
Double rewards if we hit a block, and a screen to play around
Which one matters more to you, the double reward or the screen? And what would you want to do with the screen?
Got it, both of them. Thanks, Ariel, that helps. The team will email you once you're on the Loto list. Have a good evening.
